source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

method: Every pinned Greek verse read before authoring. All verses drafted before reading prior Fluent. TSW is a post-authoring comparator, not a wording template. Each authored verse has its own rationale. F0–F3 choices are provisional; no independent review or change quota.

chapters.tsw_alignment_reason: Pinned 2:28 starts with the Father clause placed in TSW 2:27; compare 2:27–28 together. Public labels are unchanged.

TSW separates source 4:6 across public 4:6–7, shifts subsequent units and combines source 4:10–11 in public 4:11. Revised Fluent follows pinned source verse boundaries; compare 4:6–11 as a passage. TSW remains unchanged.

Revised public 13:1, like parent Fluent, includes separately bound source 12:18. TSW 13:1 begins with the beast vision and has no corresponding dragon-standing sentence at this label. Compare the source segments explicitly.
Pinned 17:9 contains the seven-kings clause placed in TSW 17:10. Compare 17:9–10 together; public labels remain unchanged.

verses.rationale: Preserves the revelation-of relation, delegated disclosure and explicit slave language.
verses.before: The revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave to him to show to his servants what must soon take place. He made it known by sending his angel to his servant John,
verses.after: The revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show his slaves what must happen soon. He made it known by sending his angel to his slave John,
verses.tsw_comparator: The revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave to him to show to his servants what must soon take place. He made it known by sending his angel to his servant John,

verses.rationale: Keeps testimony of Jesus Christ open and binds the witness to the vision.
verses.before: who bore witness to the word of God and to the testimony of Jesus Christ, even to all that he saw.
verses.after: who bore witness to God's word and the testimony of Jesus Christ—to everything he saw.
verses.tsw_comparator: who bore witness to the word of God and to the testimony of Jesus Christ, even to all that he saw.

verses.rationale: Distinguishes the singular public reader from plural hearers and retains keeping and nearness.
verses.before: Blessed is the one who reads aloud and people who hear the words of this prophecy and keep what is written in it, for the time is near.
verses.after: Blessed is the one who reads aloud, and blessed are those who hear the words of the prophecy and keep what is written in it, because the time is near.
verses.tsw_comparator: Blessed is the one who reads aloud and those who hear the words of this prophecy and keep what is written in it, for the time is near.

verses.rationale: Keeps seven spirits and the unusual divine time formula without interpreting them away.
verses.before: John to the seven churches that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from the one who is and who was and who is to come, and from the seven spirits who are before his throne,
verses.after: John, to the seven churches in Asia: grace and peace to you from the one who is and who was and who is coming, and from the seven spirits before his throne,
verses.tsw_comparator: John to the seven churches that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from the one who is and who was and who is to come, and from the seven spirits who are before his throne,

verses.rationale: Follows freed rather than washed and preserves all three titles and the unfinished doxology.
verses.before: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To the one who loves us and has freed us from our sins by his blood,
verses.after: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To the one who loves us and freed us from our sins by his blood—
verses.tsw_comparator: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To the one who loves us and has freed us from our sins by his blood,

verses.rationale: Keeps kingdom rather than kings and the relation his God and Father.
verses.before: and made us a kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen.
verses.after: and made us a kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be glory and power forever and ever. Amen.
verses.tsw_comparator: and made us a kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen.

verses.rationale: Preserves the prophetic imagery and tribes/earth range without specifying a future calendar.
verses.before: Look, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, even people who pierced him, and all the tribes of the earth will wail because of him. So it is. Amen.
verses.after: Look, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, even those who pierced him, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Yes, amen.
verses.tsw_comparator: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, even those who pierced him, and all the tribes of the earth will wail on account of him. So it is. Amen.

verses.rationale: Keeps the Greek letter names and exact divine title without an added beginning/end expansion.
verses.before: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, the one who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.
verses.after: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “the one who is and who was and who is coming, the Almighty.”
verses.tsw_comparator: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, the one who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.

verses.rationale: Preserves the three shared realities and leaves because of and testimony of open.
verses.before: I, John, your brother and partner in the affliction and kingdom and endurance that are in Jesus, was on the island called Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.
verses.after: I, John, your brother and fellow participant in the suffering, kingdom and endurance in Jesus, was on the island called Patmos because of God's word and the testimony of Jesus.
verses.tsw_comparator: I, John, your brother and partner in the affliction and kingdom and endurance that are in Jesus, was on the island called Patmos on account of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.

verses.rationale: Keeps the visionary phrase and Lord's day without supplying a weekday.
verses.before: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet
verses.after: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,
verses.tsw_comparator: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet

verses.rationale: Preserves every city in order and the shorter pinned instruction.
verses.before: saying, “Write what you see in a book and send it to the seven churches—to Ephesus and Smyrna and Pergamum and Thyatira and Sardis and Philadelphia and Laodicea.”
verses.after: saying, “Write what you see in a scroll and send it to the seven churches: Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia and Laodicea.”
verses.tsw_comparator: saying, “Write what you see in a book and send it to the seven churches—to Ephesus and Smyrna and Pergamum and Thyatira and Sardis and Philadelphia and Laodicea.”

verses.rationale: Retains the striking see-the-voice expression and repeated turning.
verses.before: Then I turned to see the voice that was speaking to me, and having turned I saw seven golden lampstands,
verses.after: I turned to see the voice that was speaking to me. When I turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,
verses.tsw_comparator: Then I turned to see the voice that was speaking to me, and having turned I saw seven golden lampstands,

verses.rationale: Keeps the son-of-man allusion, comparison and clothing details.
verses.before: and among the lampstands one like a son of man, clothed with a long robe and with a golden sash around his chest.
verses.after: and among the lampstands, one like a son of man, dressed in a robe reaching to his feet, with a golden sash around his chest.
verses.tsw_comparator: and in the midst of the lampstands one like a son of man, clothed with a long robe and with a golden sash around his chest.

verses.rationale: Preserves the doubled white and successive comparisons.
verses.before: The hair of his head was white, like wool, as white as snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire,
verses.after: His head and hair were white like white wool, like snow, and his eyes were like a flame of fire.
verses.tsw_comparator: The hair of his head was white, like wool, as white as snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire,

verses.rationale: Retains the metal and water imagery with the uncertain alloy noted.
verses.before: his feet were like burnished bronze, refined in a furnace, and his voice was like the sound of many waters.
verses.after: His feet were like burnished bronze, as though refined in a furnace, and his voice was like the sound of many waters.
verses.tsw_comparator: his feet were like burnished bronze, refined in a furnace, and his voice was like the sound of many waters.

verses.rationale: Keeps right hand, seven and the bodily sword image without explanation.
verses.before: In his right hand he held seven stars; from his mouth came a sharp two-edged sword, and his face was like the sun shining in full strength.
verses.after: In his right hand he held seven stars. A sharp, double-edged sword came out of his mouth, and his face was like the sun shining in its strength.
verses.tsw_comparator: In his right hand he held seven stars; from his mouth came a sharp two-edged sword, and his face was like the sun shining in full strength.

verses.rationale: Preserves the reaction, reassuring touch and title leading into the next verse.
verses.before: When I saw him, I fell at his feet as if dead. But he placed his right hand on me, saying, “Do not be afraid. I am the first and the last,
verses.after: When I saw him, I fell at his feet as though dead. He laid his right hand on me and said, “Do not be afraid. I am the first and the last,
verses.tsw_comparator: When I saw him, I fell at his feet as though dead. But he placed his right hand on me, saying, “Do not be afraid. I am the first and the last,

verses.rationale: Keeps death and life together and distinguishes Hades from later lake-of-fire imagery.
verses.before: and the living one. I was dead, and look, I am alive forever and ever, and I have the keys of death and Hades.
verses.after: and the living one. I was dead, and look—I am alive forever and ever! I hold the keys of Death and Hades.
verses.tsw_comparator: and the living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever, and I have the keys of death and Hades.

verses.rationale: Retains the threefold time relation without imposing a book outline.
verses.before: Write therefore what you have seen, what is, and what is about to take place after these things.
verses.after: So write what you have seen, what is, and what is to happen after these things.
verses.tsw_comparator: Write therefore what you have seen, what is, and what is about to take place after these things.

verses.rationale: Preserves the interpretation the vision itself supplies and leaves angels' identity unspecified.
verses.before: As for the mystery of the seven stars that you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lampstands: the seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
verses.after: As for the mystery of the seven stars you saw in my right hand and the seven golden lampstands: the seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are seven churches.”
verses.tsw_comparator: As for the mystery of the seven stars that you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lampstands: the seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.

verses.rationale: Keeps the recurring address formula and both images from the opening vision.
verses.before: “To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: The words of the one who holds the seven stars in his right hand, who walks among the seven golden lampstands.
verses.after: “To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These are the words of the one who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands:
verses.tsw_comparator: “To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: The words of the one who holds the seven stars in his right hand, who walks among the seven golden lampstands.

verses.rationale: Preserves the testing and its result without expanding the opponents' identity.
verses.before: I know your works, your labor and your endurance, and that you cannot bear with people who are evil, but have tested people who call themselves apostles and are not, and found them to be false.
verses.after: I know your works, your labor and your endurance. I know that you cannot tolerate evil people, and that you tested those who call themselves apostles but are not, and found them false.
verses.tsw_comparator: I know your works, your labor and your endurance, and that you cannot bear with those who are evil, but have tested those who call themselves apostles and are not, and found them to be false.

verses.rationale: Keeps endurance, bearing and labor-related weariness connected.
verses.before: I know that you are enduring and bearing up for my name’s sake, and you have not grown weary.
verses.after: You have endurance and have borne up for my name, and you have not grown weary.
verses.tsw_comparator: I know that you are enduring and bearing up for my name’s sake, and you have not grown weary.

verses.rationale: Preserves the accusation without specifying the love's object.
verses.before: But I have this against you, that you have abandoned the love you had at first.
verses.after: But I have this against you: you have abandoned the love you had at first.
verses.tsw_comparator: But I have this against you, that you have abandoned the love you had at first.

verses.rationale: Keeps both repentance clauses and the concrete threatened removal.
verses.before: Remember therefore from where you have fallen; repent, and do the works you did at first. If not, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place, unless you repent.
verses.after: Remember, then, from where you have fallen. Repent and do the works you did at first. Otherwise I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place, unless you repent.
verses.tsw_comparator: Remember therefore from where you have fallen; repent, and do the works you did at first. If not, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place, unless you repent.

verses.rationale: Retains the named group and hatred of its works.
verses.before: Yet this you have: you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
verses.after: Yet you have this in your favor: you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
verses.tsw_comparator: Yet this you have: you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

verses.rationale: Preserves the repeated hearing formula, overcoming promise and tree image.
verses.before: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who conquers I will grant to eat of the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God.
verses.after: Let anyone with an ear hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give food from the tree of life in God's paradise.
verses.tsw_comparator: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who conquers I will grant to eat of the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God.

verses.rationale: Keeps the title and death-to-life claim distinct from other addresses.
verses.before: “And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write: The words of the first and the last, who died and came to life.
verses.after: “To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of the first and the last, who was dead and came to life:
verses.tsw_comparator: “And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write: The words of the first and the last, who died and came to life.

verses.rationale: Retains the speaker's localized polemical claim without extending it to Jews generally.
verses.before: I know your affliction and your poverty (but you are rich), and the slander of people who say that they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
verses.after: I know your suffering and poverty—but you are rich—and the slander from those who say they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
verses.tsw_comparator: I know your affliction and your poverty (but you are rich), and the slander of those who say that they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

verses.rationale: Keeps the agent, test, exact duration and possible fatal cost of faithfulness.
verses.before: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Look, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested, and for ten days you will have affliction. Be faithful unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.
verses.after: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Look, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will suffer for ten days. Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested, and for ten days you will have affliction. Be faithful unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.

verses.rationale: Preserves the emphatic negative and named second death.
verses.before: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who conquers will not be harmed by the second death.
verses.after: Let anyone with an ear hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will never be harmed by the second death.
verses.tsw_comparator: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who conquers will not be harmed by the second death.

verses.rationale: Keeps the repeated address and sword's two descriptors.
verses.before: “And to the angel of the church in Pergamum write: The words of the one who has the sharp two-edged sword.
verses.after: “To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These are the words of the one who has the sharp, double-edged sword:
verses.tsw_comparator: “And to the angel of the church in Pergamum write: The words of the one who has the sharp two-edged sword.

verses.rationale: Retains the named witness, actual killing and repeated where clauses.
verses.before: I know where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. Yet you hold firmly my name, and you did not deny my faith even in the days of Antipas my faithful witness, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.
verses.after: I know where you live, where Satan's throne is. You hold firmly to my name and did not deny faith in me even in the days of Antipas, my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan lives.
verses.tsw_comparator: I know where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. Yet you hold fast my name, and you did not deny my faith even in the days of Antipas my faithful witness, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

verses.rationale: Preserves both names and both named acts without adding a narrative explanation.
verses.before: But I have a few things against you: you have some there who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the sons of Israel, so that they might eat food sacrificed to idols and practice sexual immorality.
verses.after: But I have a few things against you: you have some there who hold to Balaam's teaching. He taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat food sacrificed to idols and commit sexual immorality.
verses.tsw_comparator: But I have a few things against you: you have some there who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the sons of Israel, so that they might eat food sacrificed to idols and practice sexual immorality.

verses.rationale: Keeps the comparison without a later added hatred clause.
verses.before: So also you have some who hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
verses.after: In the same way, you also have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
verses.tsw_comparator: So also you have some who hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

verses.rationale: Retains the you/them distinction and the violent mouth-sword image.
verses.before: So repent. If not, I will come to you soon and war against them with the sword of my mouth.
verses.after: So repent. Otherwise I will come to you soon and wage war against them with the sword of my mouth.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore repent. If not, I will come to you soon and war against them with the sword of my mouth.

verses.rationale: Preserves the gifts and limited knowledge without identifying the name or stone's function.
verses.before: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who conquers I will give some of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written that no one knows except the one who receives it.
verses.after: Let anyone with an ear hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give some of the hidden manna and a white stone, with a new name written on the stone that no one knows except the one who receives it.
verses.tsw_comparator: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who conquers I will give some of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written that no one knows except the one who receives it.

verses.rationale: Keeps the title and imagery consistent with 1:14–15.
verses.before: “And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write: The words of the Son of God, who has eyes like a flame of fire, and whose feet are like burnished bronze.
verses.after: “To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like a flame of fire and whose feet are like burnished bronze:
verses.tsw_comparator: “And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write: The words of the Son of God, who has eyes like a flame of fire, and whose feet are like burnished bronze.

verses.rationale: Preserves the full list and the later/first comparison.
verses.before: I know your works, your love and faith and service and endurance, and that your latter works exceed the first.
verses.after: I know your works, your love, faith, service and endurance, and that your later works are greater than the first.
verses.tsw_comparator: I know your works, your love and faith and service and endurance, and that your latter works exceed the first.

verses.rationale: Retains the woman's specific gender and claimed role, both acts and slavery vocabulary.
verses.before: But I have this against you, that you tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess and is teaching and deceiving my servants to practice sexual immorality and to eat food sacrificed to idols.
verses.after: But I have this against you: you tolerate the woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophet and teaches and leads my slaves astray to commit sexual immorality and eat food sacrificed to idols.
verses.tsw_comparator: But I have this against you, that you tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess and is teaching and deceiving my servants to practice sexual immorality and to eat food sacrificed to idols.

verses.rationale: Keeps repeated repentance and refusal of will.
verses.before: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her immorality.
verses.after: I gave her time to repent, but she does not want to repent of her sexual immorality.
verses.tsw_comparator: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her immorality.

verses.rationale: Preserves the bed metaphor without silently adding sick and follows her works rather than their works.
verses.before: Look, I will throw her onto a sickbed, and people who commit adultery with her into great affliction, unless they repent of her works,
verses.after: Look, I am throwing her onto a bed, and those who commit adultery with her into great suffering, unless they repent of her works.
verses.tsw_comparator: Behold, I will throw her onto a sickbed, and those who commit adultery with her into great affliction, unless they repent of her works,

verses.rationale: Keeps the harsh threat and anatomical image; alternatives are explained in notes.
verses.before: and I will strike her children dead. And all the churches will know that I am the one who searches mind and heart, and I will give to each of you according to your works.
verses.after: I will put her children to death. Then all the churches will know that I am the one who searches kidneys and hearts, and I will give each of you according to your works.
verses.tsw_comparator: and I will strike her children dead. And all the churches will know that I am the one who searches mind and heart, and I will give to each of you according to your works.

subsequent_editorial_changes.previous_after: I will kill her children with death. Then all the churches will know that I am the one who searches kidneys and hearts, and I will give each of you according to your works.
subsequent_editorial_changes.rationale: Render the emphatic death expression in natural English without specifying plague or changing children to an explanatory label; retain the literal/plague possibility in the note.

verses.rationale: Retains the limited addressees and quoted characterization without endorsing the claimed depths.
verses.before: But to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not hold this teaching, who have not learned what some call the deep things of Satan, to you I say: I do not lay on you any other burden.
verses.after: But to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not hold this teaching and have not known what they call the deep things of Satan, I say: I put no other burden on you.
verses.tsw_comparator: But to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not hold this teaching, who have not learned what some call the deep things of Satan, to you I say: I do not lay on you any other burden.

verses.rationale: Preserves the simple continuing command and endpoint.
verses.before: Only hold firmly what you have until I come.
verses.after: Only hold firmly to what you have until I come.
verses.tsw_comparator: Only hold fast what you have until I come.

verses.rationale: Keeps overcoming and keeping together and carries the promise forward.
verses.before: The one who conquers and who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations,
verses.after: To the one who overcomes and keeps my works to the end, I will give authority over the nations,
verses.tsw_comparator: The one who conquers and who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations,

verses.rationale: Preserves the shepherding verb and violent comparison rather than smoothing it into a single ruling term.
verses.before: and he will rule them with a rod of iron, as when earthen pots are broken in pieces, even as I myself have received authority from my Father.
verses.after: and that person will shepherd them with an iron rod, as clay vessels are shattered,
verses.tsw_comparator: and he will rule them with a rod of iron, as when earthen pots are broken in pieces, even as I myself have received authority from my Father.

verses.rationale: Keeps the Father's prior gift and the unnamed star's promise at the source boundary.
verses.before: And I will give him the morning star.
verses.after: just as I too have received from my Father. And I will give that person the morning star.
verses.tsw_comparator: And I will give him the morning star.

verses.rationale: Repeats the source's hearing formula without stylistic variation.
verses.before: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
verses.after: Let anyone with an ear hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
verses.tsw_comparator: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

verses.rationale: Renders having a name naturally and preserves the life/death contrast.
verses.before: “And to the angel of the church in Sardis write: The words of the one who has the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your works. You have a name that you are alive, but you are dead.
verses.after: “To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of the one who has the seven spirits of God and the seven stars: I know your works. You have a reputation for being alive, but you are dead.
verses.tsw_comparator: “And to the angel of the church in Sardis write: The words of the one who has the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your works. You have a name that you are alive, but you are dead.

verses.rationale: Keeps the urgency and my God rather than generalizing the relationship.
verses.before: Wake up, and strengthen what remains and is about to die, for I have not found your works complete in the sight of my God.
verses.after: Wake up, and strengthen what remains and was about to die, for I have not found your works complete before my God.
verses.tsw_comparator: Wake up, and strengthen what remains and is about to die, for I have not found your works complete in the sight of my God.

verses.rationale: Preserves remembering, keeping and repentance and the unknown hour.
verses.before: Remember then what you received and heard. Keep it, and repent. If you will not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what hour I will come against you.
verses.after: Remember, then, what you received and heard. Keep it and repent. If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what hour I will come upon you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Remember then what you received and heard. Keep it, and repent. If you will not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what hour I will come against you.

verses.rationale: Renders names as people while retaining garments and walking imagery.
verses.before: Yet you have still a few names in Sardis, people who have not soiled their garments, and they will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.
verses.after: Yet you have a few people in Sardis who have not stained their clothes. They will walk with me in white, because they are worthy.

verses.rationale: Keeps the emphatic never, naming and public acknowledgment.

verses.after: It opened its mouth to blaspheme God, to blaspheme his name and his dwelling—those who dwell in heaven.
verses.tsw_comparator: It opened its mouth in blasphemies against God, to blaspheme his name and his dwelling, that is, those who dwell in heaven.

verses.rationale: Keeps the disturbing defeat of the holy ones and fourfold scope.
verses.before: And it was allowed to make war on the saints and to conquer them, and authority was given it over every tribe and people and language and nation,
verses.after: It was given power to wage war against the holy ones and overcome them, and it was given authority over every tribe, people, language and nation.
verses.tsw_comparator: And it was allowed to make war on the saints and to conquer them, and authority was given it over every tribe and people and language and nation,

verses.rationale: Retains the final time phrase with its attachment ambiguity documented in the note.
verses.before: and everyone who dwell on the earth will worship it, everyone whose name has not been written before the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who was slain.
verses.after: All who live on the earth will worship it, everyone whose name has not been written in the book of life of the Lamb who was slaughtered, from the foundation of the world.
verses.tsw_comparator: and all who dwell on the earth will worship it, everyone whose name has not been written before the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who was slain.

verses.rationale: Preserves the shortened hearing formula rather than importing the churches refrain.
verses.before: If someone has an ear, let him hear:
verses.after: If anyone has an ear, let them hear.
verses.tsw_comparator: If anyone has an ear, let him hear:

verses.rationale: Follows the pinned passive fate wording rather than the variant retributive whoever kills formulation.
verses.before: If someone is for captivity, into captivity he goes; if anyone is to be killed with the sword, with the sword he must be killed. Here is a call for the endurance and faith of the saints.
verses.after: If anyone is destined for captivity, into captivity they go; if anyone is to be killed by the sword, by the sword they must be killed. Here is the endurance and faith of the holy ones.
verses.tsw_comparator: If anyone is for captivity, into captivity he goes; if anyone is to be killed with the sword, with the sword he must be killed. Here is a call for the endurance and faith of the saints.

verses.rationale: Keeps earth/sea distinction and the opposed visual and vocal comparisons.
verses.before: Then I saw another beast rising out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb and it spoke like a dragon.
verses.after: I saw another beast rising from the earth. It had two horns like a lamb's, but it spoke like a dragon.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then I saw another beast rising out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb and it spoke like a dragon.

verses.rationale: Preserves the present action and the first beast's healing identifier.
verses.before: It exercises all the authority of the first beast in its presence, and it makes the earth and people who dwell in it worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.
verses.after: It exercises all the first beast's authority in its presence, and makes the earth and those who live on it worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.
verses.tsw_comparator: It exercises all the authority of the first beast in its presence, and it makes the earth and those who dwell in it worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.

verses.rationale: Keeps the signs and visible fire without supplying a mechanism.
verses.before: It performs great signs, even making fire come down from heaven to earth in front of people,
verses.after: It performs great signs, even making fire come down from heaven to earth in people's sight.
verses.tsw_comparator: It performs great signs, even making fire come down from heaven to earth in front of people,

verses.rationale: Preserves granted signs, deception and the wounded beast's image.
verses.before: and by the signs that it is allowed to perform in the presence of the beast it deceives the earth’s inhabitants, telling them to make an image for the beast that was wounded by the sword and yet lived.
verses.after: It leads those who live on the earth astray through the signs it was allowed to perform in the beast's presence. It tells them to make an image for the beast that had the sword wound and lived.
verses.tsw_comparator: and by the signs that it is allowed to perform in the presence of the beast it deceives those who dwell on the earth, telling them to make an image for the beast that was wounded by the sword and yet lived.

verses.rationale: Keeps breath, speaking and lethal coercion explicit.
verses.before: And it was allowed to give breath to the image of the beast, so that the image of the beast might even speak and cause people who would not worship the image of the beast to be killed.
verses.after: It was allowed to give breath to the beast's image, so that the image could speak and cause everyone who would not worship it to be killed.
verses.tsw_comparator: And it was allowed to give breath to the image of the beast, so that the image of the beast might even speak and cause those who would not worship the image of the beast to be killed.

verses.rationale: Preserves all three social pairs, right hand and alternative forehead.
verses.before: Also it causes all, both small and great, both rich and poor, both free and slave, to be marked on the right hand or the forehead,
verses.after: It makes everyone—small and great, rich and poor, free and slave—receive a mark on their right hand or their forehead,
verses.tsw_comparator: Also it causes all, both small and great, both rich and poor, both free and slave, to be marked on the right hand or the forehead,

verses.rationale: Keeps economic exclusion and the mark's relation to name/number.
verses.before: so that no one can buy or sell unless he has the mark, that is, the name of the beast or the number of its name.
verses.after: so that no one can buy or sell unless they have the mark: the beast's name or the number of its name.
verses.tsw_comparator: so that no one can buy or sell unless he has the mark, that is, the name of the beast or the number of its name.

verses.rationale: Keeps the calculation invitation and human/man ambiguity; the 616 variant is noted separately.
verses.before: This calls for wisdom: let the one who has understanding calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and his number is 666.
verses.after: Here is wisdom. Let the one with understanding calculate the beast's number, for it is a human number, and its number is six hundred sixty-six.
verses.tsw_comparator: This calls for wisdom: let the one who has understanding calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and his number is 666.

verses.rationale: Preserves both names and the exact number and location.
verses.before: Then I looked, and look, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him 144,000 who had his name and his Father’s name written on their foreheads.
verses.after: I looked, and there was the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, with 144,000 who had his name and his Father's name written on their foreheads.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then I looked, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him 144,000 who had his name and his Father’s name written on their foreheads.

verses.rationale: Retains all three audible comparisons and the instrument repetition.
verses.before: And I heard a voice from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of loud thunder. The voice I heard was like the sound of harpists playing on their harps,
verses.after: I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like loud thunder. The sound I heard was like harpists playing their harps.
verses.tsw_comparator: And I heard a voice from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of loud thunder. The voice I heard was like the sound of harpists playing on their harps,

verses.rationale: Preserves the pinned like, present sing and restricted learning.
verses.before: and they were singing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and before the elders. And no one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.
verses.after: They sing what is like a new song before the throne, the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been bought from the earth.
verses.tsw_comparator: and they were singing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and before the elders. And no one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.

verses.rationale: Keeps the specifically gendered sexual image and purchase/firstfruits language without interpreting them away.
verses.before: These are the ones who have not defiled themselves with women, for they are pure. These are the ones who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These have been redeemed from among mankind as firstfruits for God and the Lamb,
verses.after: These are the ones who have not defiled themselves with women, for they are virgins. These are the ones who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were bought from humanity as firstfruits for God and the Lamb,
verses.tsw_comparator: These are the ones who have not defiled themselves with women, for they are pure. These are the ones who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These have been redeemed from among mankind as firstfruits for God and the Lamb,

verses.rationale: Follows the short pinned ending without an added before the throne phrase.
verses.before: and in their mouth no lie was found; they are blameless.
verses.after: and no lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.
verses.tsw_comparator: and in their mouth no lie was found; they are blameless.

verses.rationale: Preserves eternal good news and all four audience terms.
verses.before: Then I saw another angel flying in midheaven, having an eternal good news to proclaim to the earth’s inhabitants, to every nation and tribe and language and people,
verses.after: I saw another angel flying high overhead, with eternal good news to announce to those living on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language and people.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then I saw another angel flying in midheaven, having an eternal gospel to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth, to every nation and tribe and language and people,

verses.rationale: Keeps fear, judgment and all four created realms.
verses.before: and he said with a loud voice, “Fear God and give him glory, because the hour of his judgment has come, and worship the one who made heaven and earth, the sea and the springs of water.”
verses.after: He said in a loud voice, “Fear God and give him glory, because the hour of his judgment has come. Worship the one who made heaven, earth, sea and springs of water.”
verses.tsw_comparator: and he said with a loud voice, “Fear God and give him glory, because the hour of his judgment has come, and worship the one who made heaven and earth, the sea and the springs of water.”

verses.rationale: Retains the repeated fallen and wine/sexual imagery; the passion/wrath range is noted.
verses.before: Another angel, a second, followed, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, she who has made all nations drink the wine of the passion of her immorality.”
verses.after: Another angel, a second, followed, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, who made all the nations drink the wine of the passion of her prostitution!”
verses.tsw_comparator: Another angel, a second, followed, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, she who has made all nations drink the wine of the passion of her immorality.”

verses.rationale: Keeps the sequence and both acts in the conditional warning.
verses.before: And another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a loud voice, “If someone worships the beast and its image and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,
verses.after: Another angel, a third, followed them, saying in a loud voice, “If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives a mark on their forehead or hand,
verses.tsw_comparator: And another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a loud voice, “If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,

verses.rationale: Preserves full-strength wine and torment with both witnessing groups.
verses.before: he also will drink the wine of the wrath of God, poured unmixed into the cup of his anger, and he will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.
verses.after: that person too will drink the wine of God's fury, poured full strength into the cup of his wrath, and will be tormented with fire and sulfur before the holy angels and before the Lamb.
verses.tsw_comparator: he also will drink the wine of the wrath of God, poured unmixed into the cup of his anger, and he will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.

verses.rationale: Keeps duration, absence of rest and both marked groups without resolving the doctrine beyond the text.
verses.before: And the smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever, and they have no rest, day or night, these worshipers of the beast and its image, and whoever receives the mark of its name.”
verses.after: The smoke of their torment rises forever and ever. Those who worship the beast and its image, and whoever receives the mark of its name, have no rest day or night.”
verses.tsw_comparator: And the smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever, and they have no rest, day or night, these worshipers of the beast and its image, and whoever receives the mark of its name.”

verses.rationale: Preserves the genitive faith of Jesus with its interpretive alternatives in the note.
verses.before: Here is a call for the endurance of the saints, people who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
verses.after: Here is the endurance of the holy ones, those who keep God's commands and the faith of Jesus.
verses.tsw_comparator: Here is a call for the endurance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.

verses.rationale: Keeps the writing command, from-now-on phrase, named Spirit and labor/works contrast.
verses.before: And I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write this: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow them.”
verses.after: I heard a voice from heaven say, “Write: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “they will rest from their labors, for their works follow them.”
verses.tsw_comparator: And I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write this: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow them.”

verses.rationale: Retains the comparison and implements without naming the seated figure.
verses.before: Then I looked, and look, a white cloud, and seated on the cloud one like a son of man, having a golden crown on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.
verses.after: I looked, and there was a white cloud. Seated on it was one like a son of man, with a golden crown on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then I looked, and behold, a white cloud, and seated on the cloud one like a son of man, having a golden crown on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.

verses.rationale: Renders dried harvest as ripe while preserving the command and timing.
verses.before: And another angel came out of the temple, calling with a loud voice to the one who sat on the cloud, “Put in your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come, for the harvest of the earth is fully ripe.”
verses.after: Another angel came out of the temple and cried in a loud voice to the one seated on the cloud, “Put in your sickle and reap, because the hour to reap has come: the earth's harvest is ripe.”
verses.tsw_comparator: And another angel came out of the temple, calling with a loud voice to the one who sat on the cloud, “Put in your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come, for the harvest of the earth is fully ripe.”

verses.rationale: Keeps the repeated earth and passive harvesting result.
verses.before: So the one who sat on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and the earth was reaped.
verses.after: The one seated on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and the earth was reaped.
verses.tsw_comparator: So the one who sat on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and the earth was reaped.

verses.rationale: Preserves another and the second sickle bearer.
verses.before: Then another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharp sickle.
verses.after: Another angel came out of the temple in heaven, also holding a sharp sickle.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharp sickle.

verses.rationale: Keeps the distinct angel, authority over fire and grape harvest command.
verses.before: And another angel came out from the altar, the one who has authority over the fire, and he called with a loud voice to the one who had the sharp sickle, “Put in your sickle and gather the clusters from the vine of the earth, for its grapes are ripe.”
verses.after: Another angel came from the altar, the one with authority over fire, and called in a loud voice to the angel with the sharp sickle, “Put in your sharp sickle and gather the clusters from the earth's vine, because its grapes are ripe.”
verses.tsw_comparator: And another angel came out from the altar, the one who has authority over the fire, and he called with a loud voice to the one who had the sharp sickle, “Put in your sickle and gather the clusters from the vine of the earth, for its grapes are ripe.”

verses.rationale: Preserves the gathering and throwing as separate actions and retains the winepress image.
verses.before: So the angel swung his sickle over the earth and gathered the harvest of the earth and threw it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.
verses.after: The angel swung his sickle to the earth, gathered the earth's vine and threw it into the great winepress of God's fury.
verses.tsw_comparator: So the angel swung his sickle over the earth and gathered the harvest of the earth and threw it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.

verses.rationale: Keeps the shocking height, exact distance and ancient unit with conversion only in notes.
verses.before: And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and blood flowed from the winepress, as high as a horse’s bridle, for about 1,600 stadia.
verses.after: The winepress was trodden outside the city, and blood flowed from it as high as horses' bridles for 1,600 stadia.
verses.tsw_comparator: And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and blood flowed from the winepress, as high as a horse’s bridle, for about 1,600 stadia.

verses.rationale: Preserves the repeated seven and the completed-fury claim.
verses.before: Then I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvelous: seven angels having seven plagues, which are the last, for with them the wrath of God is completed.
verses.after: I saw another sign in heaven, great and astonishing: seven angels with seven plagues, the last ones, because in them God's fury was brought to completion.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvelous: seven angels having seven plagues, which are the last, for with them the wrath of God is completed.

verses.rationale: Keeps something like, the three adversarial objects and the on/beside ambiguity in notes.
verses.before: And I saw what appeared to be a sea of glass mixed with fire, and people who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name, standing beside the sea of glass, holding harps of God.
verses.after: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who had overcome the beast, its image and the number of its name standing on the sea of glass, holding harps of God.
verses.tsw_comparator: And I saw what appeared to be a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name, standing beside the sea of glass, holding harps of God.

verses.rationale: Follows the pinned ages rather than nations or saints and preserves both songs and Moses' status.
verses.before: And they sing the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God Almighty. Just and true are your ways, O King of the nations.
verses.after: They sing the song of Moses, God's slave, and the song of the Lamb: “Great and astonishing are your works, Lord God, the Almighty. Righteous and true are your ways, King of the ages.
verses.tsw_comparator: And they sing the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God Almighty. Just and true are your ways, O King of the nations.

verses.rationale: Retains the rhetorical question, sole holiness and universal nations claim.
verses.before: Who will not fear, O Lord, and glorify your name? For you alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before you, for your righteous acts have been revealed.”
verses.after: Who will not fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you alone are holy. All the nations will come and worship before you, because your righteous acts have been revealed.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Who will not fear, O Lord, and glorify your name? For you alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before you, for your righteous acts have been revealed.”

verses.rationale: Preserves the layered temple/tent/testimony description.
verses.before: After this I looked, and the sanctuary of the tent of witness in heaven was opened,
verses.after: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tent of testimony in heaven was opened.
verses.tsw_comparator: After this I looked, and the sanctuary of the tent of witness in heaven was opened,

verses.rationale: Follows linen and preserves both sevens and the sash position.
verses.before: and out of the sanctuary came the seven angels with the seven plagues, clothed in pure, bright linen, and with golden sashes around their chests.
verses.after: The seven angels with the seven plagues came out of the temple, dressed in clean, shining linen, with golden sashes around their chests.
verses.tsw_comparator: and out of the sanctuary came the seven angels with the seven plagues, clothed in pure, bright linen, and with golden sashes around their chests.

verses.rationale: Keeps the giver, numbers, material and divine life formula.
verses.before: And one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever,
verses.after: One of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the fury of God, who lives forever and ever.
verses.tsw_comparator: And one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever,

verses.rationale: Preserves the smoke's origin, exclusion and completion condition.
verses.before: and the sanctuary was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one could enter the sanctuary until the seven plagues of the seven angels were finished.
verses.after: The temple filled with smoke from God's glory and power, and no one could enter it until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
verses.tsw_comparator: and the sanctuary was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one could enter the sanctuary until the seven plagues of the seven angels were finished.

verses.rationale: Keeps the unnamed voice and exact seven-bowl command.
verses.before: Then I heard a loud voice from the sanctuary saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out on the earth the seven bowls of the wrath of God.”
verses.after: I heard a loud voice from the temple say to the seven angels, “Go and pour the seven bowls of God's fury onto the earth.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Then I heard a loud voice from the sanctuary saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out on the earth the seven bowls of the wrath of God.”

verses.rationale: Retains the affliction's severity and specified recipients.
verses.before: So the first went and poured out his bowl on the earth, and harmful and painful sores came upon the people who bore the mark of the beast and worshiped its image.
verses.after: The first went and poured his bowl onto the earth. A foul and painful sore came upon the people who had the beast's mark and worshiped its image.
verses.tsw_comparator: So the first went and poured out his bowl on the earth, and harmful and painful sores came upon the people who bore the mark of the beast and worshiped its image.

verses.rationale: Preserves the corpse comparison and total rather than partial sea death.
verses.before: The second poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became like the blood of a dead body, and every living thing in the sea died.
verses.after: The second poured his bowl into the sea. It became blood like a dead person's, and every living being in the sea died.
verses.tsw_comparator: The second poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became like the blood of a dead body, and every living thing in the sea died.

verses.rationale: Keeps both water sources and their transformation.
verses.before: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and the springs of water, and they became blood.
verses.after: The third poured his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.
verses.tsw_comparator: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and the springs of water, and they became blood.

verses.rationale: Follows the holy one reading rather than a later shall-be expansion.
verses.before: And I heard the angel of the waters saying, “Just are you, the one who is and who was, O Holy One, for you have brought these judgments.
verses.after: I heard the angel of the waters say: “You are righteous, the one who is and who was, the holy one, because you have judged these things.
verses.tsw_comparator: And I heard the angel of the waters saying, “Just are you, the one who is and who was, O Holy One, for you have brought these judgments.

verses.rationale: Preserves the reciprocal blood imagery and the speaker's severe judgment.
verses.before: For they have poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. It is what they deserve.”
verses.after: They poured out the blood of holy ones and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve it.”
verses.tsw_comparator: For they have poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. It is what they deserve.”

verses.rationale: Retains the altar itself as speaker rather than supplying another angel.
verses.before: And I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are your judgments.”
verses.after: I heard the altar say, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, your judgments are true and righteous.”
verses.tsw_comparator: And I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are your judgments.”

verses.rationale: Keeps the solar target and permitted burning.
verses.before: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was allowed to scorch people with fire.
verses.after: The fourth poured his bowl onto the sun, and it was allowed to scorch people with fire.
verses.tsw_comparator: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was allowed to scorch people with fire.

verses.rationale: Retains the suffering, blasphemy and explicit divine authority without adding motives.
verses.before: They were scorched by the fierce heat, and they cursed the name of God who had authority over these plagues. They did not repent and give him glory.
verses.after: People were scorched with intense heat, and they blasphemed the name of God, who has authority over these plagues. They did not repent and give him glory.
verses.tsw_comparator: They were scorched by the fierce heat, and they cursed the name of God who had authority over these plagues. They did not repent and give him glory.

verses.rationale: Preserves throne/kingdom connection and the bodily expression of pain.
verses.before: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into darkness. People gnawed their tongues in anguish
verses.after: The fifth poured his bowl onto the beast's throne. Its kingdom became dark, and people gnawed their tongues in pain.
verses.tsw_comparator: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into darkness. People gnawed their tongues in anguish

verses.rationale: Keeps both afflictions and repeated refusal of repentance.
verses.before: and cursed the God of heaven because of their pain and sores. They did not repent of their works.
verses.after: They blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and sores, and did not repent of their works.
verses.tsw_comparator: and cursed the God of heaven because of their pain and sores. They did not repent of their works.

verses.rationale: Retains the named river and the stated purpose without naming later nations.
verses.before: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up, to prepare the way for the kings from the east.
verses.after: The sixth poured his bowl onto the great river Euphrates. Its water dried up to prepare the way for the kings from the east.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up, to prepare the way for the kings from the east.

verses.rationale: Preserves each repeated mouth and the frog comparison.
verses.before: And I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon and out of the mouth of the beast and out of the mouth of the false prophet three unclean spirits like frogs,
verses.after: I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come from the mouth of the dragon, the mouth of the beast and the mouth of the false prophet.
verses.tsw_comparator: And I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon and out of the mouth of the beast and out of the mouth of the false prophet three unclean spirits like frogs,

verses.rationale: Keeps the spirits' identity and worldwide gathering without substituting a modern scenario.
verses.before: for they are demonic spirits, performing signs, who go abroad to the kings of the entire world, to gather them for battle on the great day of God the Almighty.
verses.after: They are demonic spirits performing signs, and they go out to the kings of the whole inhabited world to gather them for the battle of the great day of God the Almighty.
verses.tsw_comparator: for they are demonic spirits, performing signs, who go abroad to the kings of the whole world, to gather them for battle on the great day of God the Almighty.

verses.rationale: Retains the abrupt inserted speech and literal clothing image without adding a named speaker.

verses.before: And the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, for the glory of God gives it light, and its lamp is the Lamb.
verses.after: The city has no need of the sun or moon to shine on her, because God's glory lights her, and her lamp is the Lamb.
verses.tsw_comparator: And the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, for the glory of God gives it light, and its lamp is the Lamb.

verses.rationale: Follows the short nations reading without adding of the saved and retains the tense shift.
verses.before: By its light the nations will walk, and the kings of the earth will bring their glory into it,
verses.after: The nations will walk by her light, and the kings of the earth bring their glory into her.
verses.tsw_comparator: By its light the nations will walk, and the kings of the earth will bring their glory into it,

verses.rationale: Preserves the emphatic open gates and absence of night.
verses.before: and its gates will never be shut by day—and there will be no night there.
verses.after: Her gates will never be shut by day, and there will be no night there.
verses.tsw_comparator: and its gates will never be shut by day—and there will be no night there.

verses.rationale: Keeps the unnamed plural bearers and both glory and honor.
verses.before: They will bring into it the glory and the honor of the nations.
verses.after: They will bring the glory and honor of the nations into her.
verses.tsw_comparator: They will bring into it the glory and the honor of the nations.

verses.rationale: Retains the emphatic exclusion and book-of-life condition without expanding the categories.
verses.before: But nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who does what is detestable or false, but only people who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
verses.after: Nothing unclean will ever enter her, nor anyone who practices abomination or falsehood, but only those written in the Lamb's book of life.
verses.tsw_comparator: But nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who does what is detestable or false, but only those who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.

verses.rationale: Keeps one throne with both possessors and the river's clarity.
verses.before: Then he showed me the river of the water of life, bright as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb
verses.after: He showed me a river of the water of life, bright as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb
verses.tsw_comparator: Then he showed me the river of the water of life, bright as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb

verses.rationale: Preserves the singular tree on both sides and the twelve/monthly relation without resolving the spatial image.
verses.before: through the middle of the street of the city. On either side of the river is the tree of life with its twelve kinds of fruit, producing its fruit each month, and the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.
verses.after: down the middle of the city's street. On either side of the river was the tree of life, bearing twelve crops of fruit, yielding its fruit each month. The tree's leaves are for the healing of the nations.
verses.tsw_comparator: through the middle of the street of the city. On either side of the river is the tree of life with its twelve kinds of fruit, producing its fruit each month, and the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.

verses.rationale: Keeps the curse's removal, shared throne and singular his/him with explicit slaves.
verses.before: No longer will there be anything accursed, but the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will worship him.
verses.after: There will no longer be anything accursed. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in the city, and his slaves will serve him.
verses.tsw_comparator: No longer will there be anything accursed, but the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will worship him.

verses.rationale: Preserves the singular possessives and bodily name location.
verses.before: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
verses.after: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
verses.tsw_comparator: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

verses.rationale: Keeps both light sources, divine illumination and the endless reign.
verses.before: And night will be no more. They will need no light of lamp or sun, for the Lord God will give them light, and they will reign forever and ever.
verses.after: There will be no more night. They need no lamplight or sunlight, because the Lord God will shine on them, and they will reign forever and ever.
verses.tsw_comparator: And night will be no more. They will need no light of lamp or sun, for the Lord God will give them light, and they will reign forever and ever.

verses.rationale: Follows the pinned spirits of the prophets and preserves the opening book's disclosure language.
verses.before: And he said to me, “These words are trustworthy and true. And the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent his angel to show his servants what must soon take place.”
verses.after: He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent his angel to show his slaves what must happen soon.”
verses.tsw_comparator: And he said to me, “These words are trustworthy and true. And the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent his angel to show his servants what must soon take place.”

verses.rationale: Keeps the abrupt first-person speech and blessing without imposing an explanatory speaker label.
verses.before: “And look, I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”
verses.after: “Look, I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy of this scroll.”
verses.tsw_comparator: “And behold, I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”

verses.rationale: Preserves the named witness and repeated hearing/seeing before the worship mistake.
verses.before: I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. And when I heard and saw them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who showed them to me,
verses.after: I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who showed them to me.
verses.tsw_comparator: I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. And when I heard and saw them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who showed them to me,

verses.rationale: Keeps all fellow-slave groups and the direct prohibition and command.
verses.before: but he said to me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers and sisters the prophets, and with people who keep the words of this book. Worship God.”
verses.after: He said to me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow slave with you, with your brothers and sisters the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this scroll. Worship God!”
verses.tsw_comparator: but he said to me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God.”

verses.rationale: Preserves the unsealed prophecy and near-time rationale.
verses.before: And he said to me, “Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is near.
verses.after: He said to me, “Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this scroll, because the time is near.
verses.tsw_comparator: And he said to me, “Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is near.

verses.rationale: Retains the unsettling fourfold imperatives and repeated still without smoothing them into description.
verses.before: Let the evildoer still do evil, and the filthy still be filthy, and the righteous still do right, and the holy still be holy.”
verses.after: Let the one who does wrong still do wrong; let the filthy still be filthy; let the righteous still practice righteousness; and let the holy still be holy.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Let the evildoer still do evil, and the filthy still be filthy, and the righteous still do right, and the holy still be holy.”

verses.rationale: Keeps the returning first-person voice and work-based repayment.
verses.before: “Look, I am coming soon, bringing my recompense with me, to repay each person for what he has done.
verses.after: “Look, I am coming soon, and my reward is with me, to repay each according to their work.
verses.tsw_comparator: “Behold, I am coming soon, bringing my recompense with me, to repay each one for what he has done.

verses.rationale: Preserves all three title pairs in their given order.
verses.before: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.”
verses.after: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.”
verses.tsw_comparator: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.”

verses.rationale: Follows wash robes rather than do commandments and retains access to tree and gates.
verses.before: Blessed are people who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city by the gates.
verses.after: Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and enter the city through its gates.
verses.tsw_comparator: Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city by the gates.

verses.rationale: Keeps the dogs image unexplained and all named groups and both love/practice verbs.
verses.before: Outside are the dogs and sorcerers and the sexually immoral and murderers and idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
verses.after: Outside are the dogs, sorcerers, the sexually immoral, murderers, idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
verses.tsw_comparator: Outside are the dogs and sorcerers and the sexually immoral and murderers and idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.

verses.rationale: Preserves explicit Jesus, the churches and both root/descendant and star titles.
verses.before: “I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify to you about these things for the churches. I am the root and the descendant of David, the bright morning star.”
verses.after: “I, Jesus, sent my angel to testify to you about these things for the churches. I am the Root and descendant of David, the bright morning star.”
verses.tsw_comparator: “I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify to you about these things for the churches. I am the root and the descendant of David, the bright morning star.”

verses.rationale: Keeps the repeated invitation and free gift without resolving every come to the same addressee.
verses.before: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come.” And let the one who hears say, “Come.” And let the one who is thirsty come; let the one who desires take the water of life without price.
verses.after: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Let the one who hears say, “Come!” Let the thirsty come; let anyone who wishes take the water of life freely.
verses.tsw_comparator: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come.” And let the one who hears say, “Come.” And let the one who is thirsty come; let the one who desires take the water of life without price.

verses.rationale: Preserves the unnamed first-person witness and repeated add relationship.
verses.before: I warn everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if someone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book,
verses.after: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this scroll: if anyone adds to them, God will add to that person the plagues written in this scroll.
verses.tsw_comparator: I warn everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book,

verses.rationale: Follows tree of life rather than book of life and keeps the reciprocal removal.
verses.before: and if someone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life and in the holy city, which are described in this book.
verses.after: If anyone takes away from the words of the scroll of this prophecy, God will take away that person's share in the tree of life and in the holy city described in this scroll.
verses.tsw_comparator: and if anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life and in the holy city, which are described in this book.

verses.rationale: Preserves assurance, response and direct appeal in their order.
verses.before: He who testifies to these things says, “Surely I am coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
verses.after: The one who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
verses.tsw_comparator: He who testifies to these things says, “Surely I am coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!

verses.rationale: Follows the pinned short ending with all, without adding Christ, saints or a final Amen.
verses.before: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all. Amen.
verses.after: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all.
verses.tsw_comparator: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all. Amen.
